notes_for_editor: Thin record: the only tower-specific source is the tnlandforms list row (name, coordinates, county, elevation, GFC number). No build date, design, staffing or fate found. Story says nothing about build or fate beyond the statewide 1980s context, which is general and does not say this tower was scrapped. The AllSurplus listing for a 'Fire Tower (215005 NB)' at the GFC office in Seminole County returned 403 and was not read; it is not confirmed to be this tower. The NHLR Seminole County Fire Tower (US 717, GA 12) is a different register entry at different coordinates and should not be conflated with Desser. Elevation 140 is taken as feet, matching the record's 42.7 m. Used 2 web searches. Fact-check 2026-10-21: the register's full 29-entry list was read and has no Desser entry; the elevation unit is inferred from the table scale (Brasstown 4735), not labeled on the page.
